record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Let P and Q be well-filtered dcpos, meaning each underlying poset admits a compatible well-filtered topology. Must the product dcpo P x Q be Scott well-filtered, i.e. must the Scott space Sigma(P x Q) be well-filtered?

evidence.quote: Question 4.7. Let P, Q be well-filtered dcpos. Must the product P × Q be Scott well-filtered?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Definitions. Let $(X,	au)$ be a $T_0$ topological space. A subset $K \subseteq X$ is saturated if it equals the intersection of its open neighborhoods (equivalently, $K$ is an upper set in the specialization order). The space $X$ is called well-filtered if for every filtered family $\{K_i\}_{i\in I}$ of nonempty compact saturated subsets of $X$ and every open set $U \subseteq X$, the inclusion $ igcap_{i\in I} K_i \subseteq U$ implies $K_i \subseteq U$ for some $i \in I$.

A directed complete partial order (dcpo) is a poset $P$ in which every directed subset has a supremum. The Scott topology $\sigma(P)$ on a poset $P$ has as open sets the upper sets $U$ such that whenever a directed subset $D \subseteq P$ has a supremum lying in $U$, some element of $D$ already lies in $U$; the resulting space is denoted $\Sigma P$. Call a dcpo $P$ well-filtered if its Scott space $\Sigma P$ is well-filtered.

Given two dcpos $P$ and $Q$, the product $P 	imes Q$ is again a dcpo under the coordinatewise order.

Problem. Let $P$ and $Q$ be well-filtered dcpos. Must the product dcpo $P 	imes Q$ be Scott well-filtered, i.e., must the Scott space $\Sigma(P 	imes Q)$ be well-filtered?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches turned up active research on well-filtered dcpos (papers by Xu and collaborators, 2022–2026) but no result directly resolving whether the product of two well-filtered dcpos must again be Scott well-filtered. Related work addresses products of $\omega$-well-filtered spaces and products of Scott topologies, but the specific question for well-filtered dcpos appears to remain open in the literature accessible via search.

status_evidence.title: Commutation of Smyth and Hoare Power Constructions in Well-filtered Dcpos
status_evidence.snippet: A dcpo is called well-filtered if its Scott space is well-filtered. Recent work investigates products and power constructions on well-filtered dcpos.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research continues on well-filtered dcpos without a definitive resolution to the product question.

status_evidence.title: S*-well-filtered spaces and d*-spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Xu introduces new variants of well-filtered spaces, indicating that fundamental questions about the class of well-filtered dcpos remain under study.
status_evidence.claim: Variants and related open questions are still being explored in 2026.
